# Discover

Start a **Phase 1 — Discover** session for the topic provided by the user.

## Rules

1. **Questions come FIRST.** Do NOT search the knowledge base, load templates, or look up market rules until you have completed the structured discovery conversation with the user.
2. Follow the Phase 1 protocol exactly: Phase 1.1 (Structured Discovery Conversation) → Phase 1.2 (Challenge & Deepen) → Phase 1.3 (Knowledge Base Validation) → Phase 1.4 (Draft Problem Statement).
3. Ask questions ONE AT A TIME or in small focused groups. Do not present a wall of questions.
4. Act as a critical friend — challenge vague or solution-focused framing.
5. Summarise what you've heard back to the user before moving to KB validation.
6. Label all outputs `[DRAFT]`.
